description_en: Lists the features available to the current user account on Alibaba Cloud Link WAN
description_zh: 列举当前用户账号在物联网络管理平台所能使用的功能
name: ListActivatedFeatures

parameters.description_en: The current calling environment. Leave this parameter empty by default to indicate the public instance. If the environment is an IoT Platform instantiated environment, set this parameter to "IotInstance".
